value.rationale: The ring is the distinguished first possible reversible-but-nonsymmetric example, and the defining identity asks exactly when abc=0 but acb is nonzero. Its full quantitative failure rate is a natural intrinsic statistic. More substantially, all witnesses are confined to precisely three equal radical-layer profiles, and a complete joint rank census identifies the two and only two contributing rank jumps. The qualitative ring classification and individual-rank marginals do not supply these data. This supplies a motivated benchmark for comparing the freshly classified 186 minimal examples; no artificial slice or trivial proof of existence is presented.
